en: Charles John Hutham Dickens was born on the 7th of February 1812 to John and Elizabeth Dickens.
zh: 查爾斯·約翰·哈薩姆·狄更斯於1812年2月7日出生，父母是約翰和伊麗莎白·狄更斯。
ja: チャールズ・ジョン・ハサム・ディケンズは1812年2月7日にジョンとエリザベス・ディケンズのもとに生まれました。
local: Charles John Hutham Dickens was born on the 7th of February 1812 to John and Elizabeth Dickens.
native: Charles John Hutham Dickens was born on the 7th of February 1812 to John and Elizabeth Dickens.

en: Charles was the second child of eight siblings in all, six of whom survived to adulthood.
zh: 查爾斯是八個兄弟姐妹中的第二個孩子，其中六人活到了成年。
ja: チャールズは全部で8人兄弟のうちの2番目の子供で、そのうち6人が成人まで生き延びました。
local: Charles was the second child of eight siblings in all, six of whom survived to adulthood.
native: Charles was the second child of eight siblings in all, six of whom survived to adulthood.

en: John, a neighbour clerk, always spent beyond his means.
zh: 約翰是一名鄰居的職員，總是花費超出他的能力範圍。
ja: ジョンは隣人の事務員で、いつも収入以上に使っていました。
local: John, a neighbour clerk, always spent beyond his means.
native: John, a neighbour clerk, always spent beyond his means.

en: One day he pointed out a house to Charles, remarking that he could live in such a house, if he worked hard.
zh: 有一天，他指著一棟房子對查爾斯說，如果努力工作，他也能住進那樣的房子。
ja: ある日、彼はチャールズに家を指さし、努力すればそんな家に住めると言いました。
local: One day he pointed out a house to Charles, remarking that he could live in such a house, if he worked hard.
native: One day he pointed out a house to Charles, remarking that he could live in such a house, if he worked hard.

en: The family moved to London in 1822.
zh: 這家人在1822年搬到了倫敦。
ja: 家族は1822年にロンドンに引っ越しました。
local: The family moved to London in 1822.
native: The family moved to London in 1822.

en: At 12, as the family finances worsened, Charles had to start working a blacking factory,
zh: 12歲時，隨著家裡經濟狀況惡化，查爾斯不得不開始在一家擦鞋油工廠工作，
ja: 12歳の時、家計が悪化し、チャールズは靴墨工場で働き始めなければなりませんでした。
local: At 12, as the family finances worsened, Charles had to start working a blacking factory,
native: At 12, as the family finances worsened, Charles had to start working a blacking factory,

en: labelling bottles for eleven hours a day.
zh: 每天工作十一小時標籤瓶子。
ja: 1日11時間、瓶にラベルを貼っていました。
local: labelling bottles for eleven hours a day.
native: labelling bottles for eleven hours a day.

en: John Dickens was eventually sent to a debtors prison, Charles visited him there every Sunday.
zh: 約翰·狄更斯最終被送進債務人監獄，查爾斯每個星期天都去看他。
ja: ジョン・ディケンズは最終的に債務者監獄に送られ、チャールズは毎週日曜日に彼を訪ねました。
local: John Dickens was eventually sent to a debtors prison, Charles visited him there every Sunday.
native: John Dickens was eventually sent to a debtors prison, Charles visited him there every Sunday.

en: His youth left him with an ambitious drive.
zh: 他的年輕時代給了他雄心勃勃的動力。
ja: 彼の若さは野心的な原動力を与えました。
local: His youth left him with an ambitious drive.
native: His youth left him with an ambitious drive.

en: In 1827, he began work as a solicitous clerk.
zh: 1827年，他開始做一名細心的職員。
ja: 1827年、彼は細心な事務員として働き始めました。
local: In 1827, he began work as a solicitous clerk.
native: In 1827, he began work as a solicitous clerk.

en: From the surroundings of his unremarkable office, he began to collect names and characteristics of the people he saw.
zh: 在他那不起眼的辦公室周圍，他開始收集他所見人們的名字和特徵。
ja: 目立たない彼のオフィスの周囲から、彼は見かけた人々の名前や特徴を集め始めました。
local: From the surroundings of his unremarkable office, he began to collect names and characteristics of the people he saw.
native: From the surroundings of his unremarkable office, he began to collect names and characteristics of the people he saw.

en: Charles began a journalistic career in 1831.
zh: 查爾斯於1831年開始了新聞記者的生涯。
ja: チャールズは1831年にジャーナリストとしてのキャリアを始めました。
local: Charles began a journalistic career in 1831.
native: Charles began a journalistic career in 1831.

en: Writing became his passion, working for paper by day and on his own work by night.
zh: 寫作成為他的熱情，白天為報紙工作，晚上寫自己的作品。
ja: 執筆は彼の情熱となり、昼は新聞のために働き、夜は自分の作品に取り組みました。
local: Writing became his passion, working for paper by day and on his own work by night.
native: Writing became his passion, working for paper by day and on his own work by night.

en: He was beginning to taste success.
zh: 他開始嘗到成功的滋味。
ja: 彼は成功の味を感じ始めていました。
local: He was beginning to taste success.
native: He was beginning to taste success.

en: His first piece of fiction was published in 1835.
zh: 他的第一部小說於1835年出版。
ja: 彼の最初の小説は1835年に出版されました。
local: His first piece of fiction was published in 1835.
native: His first piece of fiction was published in 1835.

en: That same year Charles met Catherine Hogarth, they fell in love and were married.
zh: 同年，查爾斯遇見了凱瑟琳·霍加斯，他們相愛並結婚了。
ja: 同じ年にチャールズはキャサリン・ホガースと出会い、恋に落ちて結婚しました。
local: That same year Charles met Catherine Hogarth, they fell in love and were married.
native: That same year Charles met Catherine Hogarth, they fell in love and were married.

en: The next few years of fervent activity resulted in much writing and many children.
zh: 接下來幾年的熱烈活動帶來了大量的寫作和許多孩子。
ja: その後数年間の熱心な活動は、多くの執筆と多くの子供をもたらしました。
local: The next few years of fervent activity resulted in much writing and many children.
native: The next few years of fervent activity resulted in much writing and many children.

en: As his writing became more popular and his fame, more widespread,
zh: 隨著他的作品越來越受歡迎，他的名聲也越來越廣泛，
ja: 彼の作品がより人気を博し、名声が広まるにつれて、
local: As his writing became more popular and his fame, more widespread,
native: As his writing became more popular and his fame, more widespread,

en: rumours began to abound of his drunkenness and admission to an asylum.
zh: 謠言開始流傳他酗酒和被送入精神病院。
ja: 彼の酔っぱらい癖や精神病院への入院の噂が広まり始めました。
local: rumours began to abound of his drunkenness and admission to an asylum.
native: rumours began to abound of his drunkenness and admission to an asylum.

en: Stories were easy to concoct about the writer who kept a pet raven
zh: 關於這位養了一隻寵物渡鴉的作家，故事很容易被編造出來
ja: ペットのカラスを飼っていた作家についての話は簡単に作り上げられました。
local: Stories were easy to concoct about the writer who kept a pet raven
native: Stories were easy to concoct about the writer who kept a pet raven

en: and who writing dealt in the extremes of the sentimental and the grotesque.
zh: 他的寫作涉及感傷與怪誕的極端風格。
ja: 彼の作品は感傷的で奇怪な極端な内容を扱っていました。
local: and who writing dealt in the extremes of the sentimental and the grotesque.
native: and who writing dealt in the extremes of the sentimental and the grotesque.

en: In 1842, Charles and Catherine set sail for America on landing in Boston.
zh: 1842年，查爾斯和凱瑟琳啟航前往美國，抵達波士頓。
ja: 1842年、チャールズとキャサリンはアメリカへ向けて出航し、ボストンに上陸しました。
local: In 1842, Charles and Catherine set sail for America on landing in Boston.
native: In 1842, Charles and Catherine set sail for America on landing in Boston.

en: They were mocked by crowds.
zh: 他們被群眾嘲笑。
ja: 彼らは群衆に嘲笑されました。
local: They were mocked by crowds.
native: They were mocked by crowds.

en: Dickens' interest lay in visiting the unusual which inspired his writing.
zh: 狄更斯對於拜訪不尋常的事物感興趣，這啟發了他的寫作。
ja: ディケンズは珍しい場所を訪れることに興味を持ち、それが彼の執筆のインスピレーションとなりました。
local: Dickens' interest lay in visiting the unusual which inspired his writing.
native: Dickens' interest lay in visiting the unusual which inspired his writing.

en: He took his whole family on his next big trip to Italy in the summer of 1844.
zh: 1844年夏天，他帶著全家進行了下一次重要的義大利之旅。
ja: 彼は1844年の夏に家族全員を連れてイタリアへの大きな旅に出かけました。
local: He took his whole family on his next big trip to Italy in the summer of 1844.
native: He took his whole family on his next big trip to Italy in the summer of 1844.

en: Upon his return, Dickens began to look for new diversions.
zh: 回國後，狄更斯開始尋找新的消遣方式。
ja: 帰国後、ディケンズは新しい気晴らしを探し始めました。
local: Upon his return, Dickens began to look for new diversions.
native: Upon his return, Dickens began to look for new diversions.

en: He helped to start and edit a radical newspaper, founded a refuge for homeless women
zh: 他協助創辦並編輯了一份激進報紙，並創立了無家可歸婦女的庇護所
ja: 彼は急進的な新聞の創刊と編集を手伝い、ホームレスの女性のための避難所を設立しました。
local: He helped to start and edit a radical newspaper, founded a refuge for homeless women
native: He helped to start and edit a radical newspaper, founded a refuge for homeless women

en: and performed his works at public readings.
zh: 並在公開朗讀會上表演他的作品。
ja: そして彼の作品を公開朗読会で披露しました。
local: and performed his works at public readings.
native: and performed his works at public readings.

en: aged 44, Charles bought Gads Hill.
zh: 44歲時，查爾斯買下了加茲山莊。
ja: 44歳の時、チャールズはギャッズ・ヒルを購入しました。
local: aged 44, Charles bought Gads Hill.
native: aged 44, Charles bought Gads Hill.

en: The house's father had pointed out to him all those years before.
zh: 那是多年前他父親曾指給他看的房子。
ja: その家は何年も前に彼の父親が彼に指し示したものでした。
local: The house's father had pointed out to him all those years before.
native: The house's father had pointed out to him all those years before.

en: It symbolised a pinnacle of achievement.
zh: 它象徵著成就的巔峰。
ja: それは達成の頂点を象徴していました。
local: It symbolised a pinnacle of achievement.
native: It symbolised a pinnacle of achievement.

en: Whilst Dickens was organising a theatrical project, the frozen deep,
zh: 當狄更斯正在籌劃一個名為《冰封深淵》的戲劇項目時，
ja: ディケンズが劇場プロジェクト『フローズン・ディープ』を企画している間、
local: Whilst Dickens was organising a theatrical project, the frozen deep,
native: Whilst Dickens was organising a theatrical project, the frozen deep,

en: he met and was spellbound by a young actress, Ellen Ternan.
zh: 他遇見並被一位年輕女演員艾倫·特南迷住了。
ja: 彼は若い女優エレン・ターナンに出会い、魅了されました。
local: he met and was spellbound by a young actress, Ellen Ternan.
native: he met and was spellbound by a young actress, Ellen Ternan.

en: There is much speculation about this relationship that caused the end of his marriage to Catherine.
zh: 關於這段關係導致他與凱瑟琳婚姻結束，有許多猜測。
ja: この関係が彼のキャサリンとの結婚の終わりをもたらしたと、多くの推測があります。
local: There is much speculation about this relationship that caused the end of his marriage to Catherine.
native: There is much speculation about this relationship that caused the end of his marriage to Catherine.

en: One fake full night in 1865, whilst Charles and Ellen were returning from palace,
zh: 1865年某個假夜晚，當查爾斯和艾倫從宮殿返回時，
ja: 1865年のある夜、チャールズとエレンが宮殿から帰る途中、
local: One fake full night in 1865, whilst Charles and Ellen were returning from palace,
native: One fake full night in 1865, whilst Charles and Ellen were returning from palace,

en: their trained crash after the state of rest.
zh: 他們的馬車在休息狀態後發生了撞車事故。
ja: 彼らの馬車は休憩後に衝突事故を起こしました。
local: their trained crash after the state of rest.
native: their trained crash after the state of rest.

en: Dickens administered brandy and water to the injured and dying.
zh: 狄更斯給受傷和垂死的人們提供了白蘭地和水。
ja: ディケンズは負傷者や瀕死の人々にブランデーと水を与えました。
local: Dickens administered brandy and water to the injured and dying.
native: Dickens administered brandy and water to the injured and dying.

en: Only at the last minute did you remember to retrieve the final part of our mutual friend from the wrecked carriage.
zh: 直到最後一刻，他才想起從毀壞的馬車中取回《我們共同的朋友》的最後部分。
ja: 最後の瞬間になって、彼は壊れた馬車から『我らが共通の友』の最後の部分を取り戻すことを思い出しました。
local: Only at the last minute did you remember to retrieve the final part of our mutual friend from the wrecked carriage.
native: Only at the last minute did you remember to retrieve the final part of our mutual friend from the wrecked carriage.

en: The incident left Charles very shaken.
zh: 這起事件讓查爾斯非常震驚。
ja: この出来事はチャールズを非常に動揺させました。
local: The incident left Charles very shaken.
native: The incident left Charles very shaken.

en: For a while he maintained his busy itinerary, then his health began to fail.
zh: 他一度維持忙碌的行程，然後健康開始惡化。
ja: しばらくの間、彼は忙しい日程を維持しましたが、その後健康が悪化し始めました。
local: For a while he maintained his busy itinerary, then his health began to fail.
native: For a while he maintained his busy itinerary, then his health began to fail.

en: At home on Wednesday the 9th of June 1870, at the age of 58, Charles suffered a stroke and died.
zh: 1870年6月9日星期三，在家中，58歲的查爾斯中風去世。
ja: 1870年6月9日水曜日、自宅で58歳のチャールズは脳卒中で亡くなりました。
local: At home on Wednesday the 9th of June 1870, at the age of 58, Charles suffered a stroke and died.
native: At home on Wednesday the 9th of June 1870, at the age of 58, Charles suffered a stroke and died.

en: He's buried in Westminster Abbey.
zh: 他安葬於西敏寺。
ja: 彼はウェストミンスター寺院に埋葬されています。
local: He's buried in Westminster Abbey.
native: He's buried in Westminster Abbey.
